newsitem.title: CHINA: Eastern Comm to issue 40 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Comm to issue 40 mln A shares.

text.p: China's Eastern Communications plans to issue 40 million domestic A shares and list them on the Shanghai stock exchange in November, a company official said on Tuesday.
The offer has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission but the precise date and price of the issue has yet to be decided, the official said.
China Guotai Securities Co has been appointed as the lead underwriter, he said.

After the issue, Eastern Communications will have a total share capital of 380 million, including 100 million B shares listed in August in Shanghai and 240 million shares held by state-owned institutions.

In the first half of 1996, the company posted a net profit of 170.79 million yuan on turnover of 2.282 billion yuan. In the whole of 1995, the company posted a net profit of 262.47 million yuan on turnover of 3.315 billion yuan.
